stale_condition: Both source date and final-decision date precede today minus 6 calendar days
decision_record: archive_decision: decision, decided_at, human_reference; merged additionally target_path, release_commit, release_verified=true
do_not_infer_closed_from: audit/PR report merged; candidate status alone; age alone; an absent human reply
lossless_recovery: Original closed candidate data remain in a verified immutable source Git commit and the pre-cleanup backup; summary records source path, commit, SHA-256, decision and evidence. No placeholder originals.
delete_scope: Only verified stale closed candidate JSON after summary/index persistence; retain shared reports, budgets and unresolved candidates
daily_read_scope: Date directories from today-6 through today only, plus small active-index metadata; never automatically open older unresolved bodies or archive/
older_unresolved: Remain pending with metadata pointer; open the exact older item only on explicit targeted review/cleanup, not the daily sweep
publication: fixed main -> backup and verification -> local compact -> PR -> inspect actual diff -> merge -> independent main readback
